I'm finally caught up enough on my backlog of reading to be 100% completely and utterly... behind again.

Nightwing Rebirth & Nightwing #001-#007 - It was a good starter for me, and got me invested in the DCU once again. I'm not super-exposed to Dick (Devon would've loved that line), so I couldn't really say whether the writing does his character justice.

What I can say is that it was good enough to keep me around. The story so far largely centers around Nightwing's interactions with a fella named Raptor. Thematically, it touches a lot on Nightwing's perception of himself, as well as where he relates to the rest of the world. Is hew his own man, or is he just an extension of Batman's "brand"?

Red Hood and the Outlaws Rebirth & RHATO #001-#003 - It kicked off with a nice showdown between Red and the Bat. I'm kinda sad to see Starfire and Roy replaced, but Artemis has always been a guilty interest of mine, so I'm glad to see her getting a real spotlight for once.

Cyborg Rebirth - I wasn't compelled. To be fair, I wan't expecting to be wowed by the first issue, but I found Cyborg's particularly underwhelming. I'm going to stick with it for now, mainly because the end was interesting. Without spoiling it too much, Cyborg's sense of self gets shattered. Maybe I didn't like it as much as I should have because I's already been kind of travelling down that road with Nightwing. I'd be interested in hearing your thoughts.

Teen Titans Rebirth & Teen Titans #001 - Damien is such a prick. It's awesome. And also strange, because I was kind of still on the fence about him in the DCAOM universe. But in print, he's a cocky riot.

Titans Rebirth & Titans #001-#004 - I'll keep reading. Also, am I the only one on the planet that thinks Donna and Dick should be together rather than Dick and Batgirl? Because I feel like I am. Also, Donna Troy is the better Wonder Woman. She isn't Superman with tits, she doesn't get hung up on herself, and she doesn't need to constantly call out men and show them up because of her own insecurities. There, I said it.

Deathstroke Rebirth & Deathstroke #001-#005 - Get it. I think this is my most favourite series about a villain so far since Secret Six. My favorite panels were this exchange between Deathstroke and Damian. That kid is fucking brutal.

Where all of the titles are concerned, the art was what I've come to expect from DC's current titles. It's good, but very... I don't know. Standardized. At least it's not the soulless Disney assembly-line shit coming out of Marvel. So there's that.
